scope: Synthetic scoring only. First global confirmed/actionable track need not identify the same fish as the first matching fragment. Native raw probability can differ in geometry/time from filtered diagnostics.
runtime: Shared GPU; measured inference time is diagnostic, not an isolated latency benchmark or injected simulation delay.
